title: AI Persuasion as a Threat to Human Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.14796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The threat that AI persuasion poses to human control has been acknowledged in the literature, but not yet systematically studied. Now that persuasion attacks are no longer theoretical - with Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 recently making headlines for trying to convince people involved in an open-source project to merge malicious code during an evaluation - there is a pressing need to deeply analyze this threat. We undertake that effort here. In particular, we analyze how AI could persuade humans in key settings (e.g. safety-relevant R&D within frontier labs) toward decisions that compromise the development, containment, oversight, and governance of AI itself. In doing so, we elucidate a framework for characterizing this threat, develop five concrete scenarios using this framework, and provide a blueprint for assessing the associated risks. translated_title: 人工智能说服对人类控制权的威胁
translated_abstract: 人工智能说服对人类控制构成的威胁已在文献中得到承认，但尚未得到系统性研究。如今，说服攻击已不再是理论假设——Anthropic的Claude Mythos 5最近因在一次评估中试图说服参与开源项目的人员合并恶意代码而登上新闻头条——因此迫切需要对这一威胁进行深入分析。我们在本文中承担了这项工作。具体而言，我们分析了AI如何在关键场景中（例如前沿实验室中与安全相关的研发工作）说服人类做出损害AI自身的开发、遏制、监督和治理的决策。在此过程中，我们阐明了一个用于刻画这一威胁的框架，基于该框架构建了五个具体场景，并提供了评估相关风险的蓝图。利用该蓝图，我们精选研究人员开展了初步的风险估计调查，并发现……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了AI说服对人类控制权的威胁，提出了刻画该威胁的分析框架、五个具体风险场景和风险评估蓝图，并通过初步调查证实了该风险的真实性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic analysis of AI persuasion as a threat to human control, providing a threat characterization framework, five concrete scenarios, and a risk assessment blueprint, with an initial survey of researchers confirming the risk is real.
